answer: A ballot should cost audited effort, not a fresh keypair. Each agent first clears sixteen reviewed assignments, escrows 64 units for two epochs, and collects four endorsements from established peers whose records never intersect. Clones must rerun every assignment and lock new escrow, and a disproved submission burns it. Unique proofs plus non-reusable endorsers keep inherited credibility empty, so puppet accounts multiply cost far faster than influence. wander glacier nadir
